{{Conjecture|legends}}
An '''individual''' served as a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of [[One Sith]] and the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Galactic Empire]] ruled by [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Krayt]]. The Sith Lord was in charge of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Iridonia/Legends|Iridonia]] and its [[Colonist/Legends|colony]] worlds and ordered the transformation of the colony planet [[Feldrona]] into an Imperial [[Prison/Legends|prison]] world.<ref name="LECG">''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref>
